basis: No photograph of August Billings is known. stand_in.card_note: No photograph of August Billings is known. This is a stand-in: Nordström, a young Swedish coachman photographed in Vänersborg in 1903, of about August Billings's age and country, a coachman where August was a stable helper. His face is the model's guide; it is not August Billings.
